criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.5-6: four coverage paragraphs (urinary tract obstruction shunt, CCAM/sequestration resection or shunt, sacrococcygeal teratoma, myelomeningocele) each an ALL-of list with gestational-age thresholds; then investigational conditions.
procedures_covered: Vesico-amniotic shunting for fetal urinary tract obstruction
Open in utero resection of malformed pulmonary tissue or thoracoamniotic shunt (CCAM, bronchopulmonary sequestration)
In utero removal of sacrococcygeal teratoma
Not covered: temporary tracheal occlusion for congenital diaphragmatic hernia; congenital heart defects; all others

logic.top_level: pathways: four procedures, each 'under the following conditions' as an all-of list with AND tokens
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Myelomeningocele repair has a separate 'considered experimental or investigational in the following' list: fetal anomaly unrelated to MMC, severe fetal kyphosis, risk of preterm birth (short cervix, prior preterm birth), maternal BMI of 35 kg/m2 or more.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: There is evidence of fetal hydrops, placentomegaly, and/or the beginnings of severe pre-eclampsia (i.e., the maternal mirror syndrome) in the mother.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' makes it an any-of of three findings; 'evidence of ... in the mother' also applies to fetal hydrops, which is a fetal finding.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In utero repair of myelomeningocele may be considered meets the definition of medical necessity under the following conditions:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Garbled grammar ('may be considered meets'); the verb softens the rule.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individuals who meet the conditions for in utero repair of myelomeningocele should be counseled in a nondirective fashion regarding all management options
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Sits as the last bullet of the AND list but is a recommendation, not a condition; indistinguishable by format.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: One HCPCS code per procedure (S2401 urinary tract obstruction, S2402 CCAM, S2403 extralobar sequestration, S2404 myelomeningocele, S2405 SCT) which maps one-to-one to the paragraphs; S2400 (tracheal occlusion for CDH) is tagged '(investigational)'. No ICD-10 list.

external_dependencies.quote: Refer coverage requests for in utero fetal surgery to the Medical Director for approval.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: an abnormal small amount of amniotic fluid; the presence of less than 300ml of amniotic fluid at term.
the clinical condition in infants or cardiac decompensation with hepatosplenomegaly, of the fetus before birth.

vague_terms.problem: no lab values or fetal urine criteria.
definition is at term only, 'progressive' undefined.

vague_terms.quote: No other lethal abnormalities or chromosomal defects.
vague_terms.problem: requires a negative; evidence is absence of findings.

Description is a long literature review (~180 lines) before the Position Statement; the Position Statement heading therefore starts at about line 205.
LOINC table printed under BILLING/CODING with a three-line wrapped header cell.

interesting_structures: Gestational-age cutoffs and maternal findings: conditions on mother and fetus.

Exclusion list for one pathway (MMC) only.

fit_to_tree.why: four all-of lists with numeric thresholds and an exclusion list, a good fit; chart evidence may be fetal imaging reports, and 'adequate renal function' needs judgment.
